name: Consolidate CLI verbs into a minimal, memorable command set
goal: Propose and implement a reduced command vocabulary that collapses redundant verbs while preserving capability. Coordinate with bc9c51e0 (termination unification): adopt a single lifecycle create->approve->start->finish with --disposition for expedition/mission; unify validate/verify/govern into 'check' (--dry-run|--full, --repair); unify status/checkpoint/explain status/report into 'status'; unify init/bootstrap/genesis/discover/migrate into 'init'. Deliverable: command-map migration plan + deprecated-alias shims + docs update.

metadata.refinementNote: FINAL DESIGN: one shared verb vocabulary across mission+expedition (create->approve->start->finish --disposition complete|archive|cancel; evidence/show/list/report/move/delete explicit). check=validate; check --full absorbs validate --full + verify(no-sub) + govern validation; check --repair=repair. govern=release gate (build+test+audit+proof). verify=signatures only. status absorbs checkpoint; explain=deep; init/--import absorbs discover+migrate. doctor absorbs support verbs. Implement AFTER loader lands.
